beaver.definition:
n. the soft brown fur of the beaver
n. a full beard
n. a movable piece of armor on a medieval helmet used to protect the lower face
n. a hat made with the fur of a beaver (or similar material)
beaver.translation:
n. 海狸(毛皮)
[机] 轻型及中型飞机加油

beaver away.translation: 忙于（某事）, 勤奋工作

beaver board.translation: 画油画的一种人造纤维板

beaver state.translation:
na. 〈美〉Oregon 州的别名
[网络] 海狸之州；河狸州；海獭之州

beaverbrook.definition: n. British newspaper publisher and politician (born in Canada); confidant of Winston Churchill (1879-1964)
beaverbrook.translation: 比弗布鲁克(Willian Maxwell Aitken, Lord, 1879-1964, 生于加拿大的英国出版家)

beaverbrooks.definition:
-s form of Beaverbrook
n. British newspaper publisher and politician (born in Canada); confidant of Winston Churchill (1879-1964)
beaverbrooks.translation: (Beaverbrook 的第三人称 -s形式) 比弗布鲁克(Willian Maxwell Aitken, Lord, 1879-1964, 生于加拿大的英国出版家)

beavercreek.translation: 比弗克里克（美国俄亥俄州西南部一村庄，代顿的一个居住郊区。人口33， 626）

beavered.definition: a. Covered with, or wearing, a beaver or hat.
beavered.translation: v. （海狸似地）拼命工作( beaver的过去式和过去分词 ); 忙于（某事）, 勤奋工作

beaverette.translation: n. 人造海狸皮, [军]轻装甲车

beavering.translation: v. （海狸似地）拼命工作( beaver的现在分词 ); 忙于（某事）, 勤奋工作

beavers.definition:
n the soft brown fur of the beaver
n a native or resident of Oregon
n a full beard
n a man's hat with a tall crown; usually covered with silk or with beaver fur
n a movable piece of armor on a medieval helmet used to protect the lower face
n a hat made with the fur of a beaver (or similar material)
n large semiaquatic rodent with webbed hind feet and a broad flat tail; construct complex dams and underwater lodges
v work hard on something
beavers.translation:
n. 海狸( beaver的名词复数 ); 海狸皮毛; 棕灰色; 拼命工作的人
v. （海狸似地）拼命工作( beaver的第三人称单数 ); 忙于（某事）, 勤奋工作

beaverteen.definition:
n. A kind of fustian made of coarse twilled cotton, shorn
   after dyeing.
beaverteen.translation: 仿海狸皮绒布, [纺]粗斜纹绒布

beaverton.translation: n. 比佛顿（美国俄勒冈州西北部城镇名）

beavery.translation: 河狸生存或饲养的地方
